trend: First X introduction: who we are and what we make
why: Pin this so anyone who lands on the brand profile knows what SILT is.
text:
Hi X. We're SILT, a wellness brand from India for busy professionals.

We make two drink mixes: Mornings for steady energy without the 3 PM crash, and Nights for a mind that switches off. Every dose is on the pack, with no melatonin, added sugar or maltodextrin.

Ask us anything.
